_about: PROPOSED research policy for BE-Q04 (per-source, per-use rights) and BE-Q05 (retention mapping). Drafted 2026-09-29 by the implementer under the owner's delegation. It has NO effect until the owner records one approval over this file's exact SHA-256 with `make approve-research-policy BY="<name>"` (app/research/policy_approval.py). Editing any byte invalidates an existing approval. Legal terms for exchange-hosted material were NOT retrievable (NSE timed out, BSE 403/Akamai on 2026-09-29); every verdict below therefore rests on the issuer's own statutory publication duty and the investor's private use, and no exchange-hosted fetch adapter is proposed.

source_rights._uses: METADATA, STORE, EXTRACT, READ, MODEL_DISCLOSE are app/research/source_policy.py uses; export is app/db/workspace_privacy.py EXPORT_VERDICTS (EXPORT_ALLOWED | METADATA_ONLY | UNDECIDED).

conditions: Private to the uploading investor; never shared across tenants.
Model disclosure only on the investor's own explicit task or report request, to the endpoint they chose or the BT-P02 report worker.
Export returns the investor's own upload to the same investor only.
USER_DOCUMENT.basis: The investor supplied the bytes for their own private analysis (DPDP: the data principal's own material). Upload alone does not grant redistribution, so nothing beyond the uploading investor is permitted.

conditions: Per-investor private copy only; no public redistribution.
Attribute to the issuer with the origin URL and publication date.
Retrieve from the issuer's own website (LODR Reg 46) or an investor upload; exchange-hosted retrieval is not covered (terms not retrieved).
ANNUAL_REPORT.basis: Annual reports are published by the issuer to all shareholders and on its website under Companies Act 2013 s.136 and SEBI LODR Reg 34/46. Private analysis and quotation with attribution is the normal investor use; export of the bytes is withheld because republication is not the investor's right.

RESULTS.basis: Financial results are published under SEBI LODR Reg 33 and Reg 46 (issuer website). Same private-use reasoning as ANNUAL_REPORT.

conditions: Only via investor upload or the issuer's own website until exchange terms are reviewed; NSE/BSE-hosted copies are not fetched.
EXCHANGE_FILING.basis: Material disclosures under SEBI LODR Reg 30 are also required on the issuer website (Reg 46). Exchange terms were not retrievable, so the right claimed is the issuer-publication right only.

PRESENTATION.basis: Investor presentations are disclosed under LODR Reg 30 / Schedule III Part A para 15 and Reg 46.

conditions: Issuer-published transcripts only; a third-party (vendor) transcript is NEWS-class and denied.
TRANSCRIPT.basis: Earnings-call audio/transcripts must be published by the issuer under LODR Schedule III Part A para 15 and Reg 46(2)(oa).

SHAREHOLDING.basis: Quarterly shareholding pattern is filed under LODR Reg 31 and published on the issuer website.

conditions: Issuer-published commentary only (press releases, letters to shareholders).
MANAGEMENT_COMMENTARY.basis: Issuer press releases are Reg 30 disclosures. Interviews in media are NEWS and denied.

conditions: Citation (headline, publisher, URL, date) only. No licensed news feed exists; coverage is stated as unavailable, never as complete.
NEWS.basis: Publisher content is copyrighted and usually licensed; no licence is held (NEEDS-LICENCE).

retention._about: Maps each workspace privacy category to a retention_policy entity_type. app/db/retention.py only REPORTS what is due; nothing deletes on a timer. Start event = the investor's last activity (transactions OR research), as due_for_deletion already measures. Every category is erased with the investor (ON DELETE CASCADE) on a verified erasure request, and an open legal_hold suspends deletion for all of them. Minimum audit survives erasure as today (audit_log, 5 years).

RESEARCH_RECORD.basis: The investor's own research is kept for the same horizon as the account it belongs to (investor: 5 years) so an active or recently active researcher never loses it; erasure on request is immediate.

INVESTOR_NOTEBOOK.basis: Sensitive process observations (BUTLER_INVESTOR_MEMORY): the shortest horizon the retention_policy table allows (1 year), and the investor can purge it at any time via opt-out.

HOSTED_JOB.basis: Operational job/budget/checkpoint records have no value to the investor after a year; 1 year also covers DPDP's access-log minimum.
